tabs.html:
Dell / Mellanox MFA1A00 Compatible 100G QSFP28 Infiniband EDR AOC Cable – 10M LSZH High-Speed Optical Interconnect

Enhance your data center and high-performance computing infrastructure with the Dell / Mellanox MFA1A00 Compatible 100G QSFP28 Infiniband EDR Active Optical Cable – 10M LSZH. This premium-quality AOC offers blazing-fast 100Gbps data transfer speeds over a 10-meter range, ensuring minimal latency and superior signal integrity. Fully compatible with Dell and Mellanox systems, this active optical cable meets Infiniband EDR standards, making it ideal for bandwidth-intensive applications such as cloud computing, AI, and storage networks.

The LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen) jacket provides fire safety compliance, making it suitable for environmentally controlled data centers. Plug-and-play functionality allows for effortless deployment in QSFP28 ports without additional configuration.


Key Features:

  • 100G High-Speed Transmission – Supports up to 100Gbps over QSFP28 interfaces
  • Infiniband EDR Compliant – Delivers low-latency, high-bandwidth performance
  • 10 Meter Length – Ideal for medium-range interconnects in dense server environments
  • Active Optical Cable (AOC) – Superior signal integrity over long distances
  • Dell / Mellanox Compatible – Fully tested for plug-and-play use with major platforms
  • LSZH Jacket – Flame-retardant and halogen-free for safe, eco-friendly installations
  • Hot Pluggable – Easy installation without system downtime
  • Low Power Consumption – Energy-efficient design for modern data centers

Technical Specifications:

Model: MFA1A00

Cable Type: Active Optical Cable (AOC)

Connector Type: QSFP28 to QSFP28

Data Rate: 100Gbps

Cable Length: 10 meters

Jacket Type LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen)

Power Consumption < 3.5W typical

Compatibility: Dell, Mellanox, and other QSFP28 ports

Operating Temp: 0°C to 70°C

Storage Temp : -40°C to 85°C
